body:
## What it does

Bundles a large skill library for building things with an advisory council of specialist voices covering engineering, business and the general automation of a life. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer. It is built as a team of bots rather than a single one, so the roles stay separate.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @NickADobos shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
